parts.t: RECIPE 10 — The social automation family: four videos, one build
Four of the twelve you flagged teach the same thing. This is one page for all four, rather than four pages that repeat each other — your own rule, applied to itself:
"most likely repetitive, so we can put it all together... referenced correctly"
What they all are
All four end at the same place: a post appearing on several social platforms without you touching them. All four route through her own $29/month product.
You do not post to social media as a business. If that stays true, none of these four is for you.
What each one ADDS — measured, not guessed
From Google Drive to Social Media
The trigger is a Drive folder. Drop a photo in, AI looks at the picture, writes the caption, posts it. Built by a guest, Kevin, in Malta
Automate Social Media (Blotato Beginner)
The plainest walkthrough. Brand kits, multiple brands, analytics, DM automations, connecting it to Claude
Viral Reels clone machine
A free n8n template, linked in the description. Uses Airtable + Apify + HeyGen
Repurpose Instagram Reels with Human Approval
An approval step before anything posts, plus an error log. Built in Make.com
🚨 The two reel videos are the SAME automation, built twice
Ten days apart, October 2025:
If you ever build one, build the second. It is the same thing with a step where a human looks before it publishes — and that is the only meaningful difference.
💸 A cost warning neither video mentions, and it is yours
Both reel videos use Apify to download the Instagram video.
You pay for Apify — US$29/month — and your own ledger last read it at 96.3% of its included credit, US$27.93 of US$29, with US$1.07 left.
Running either of these automations spends that. Neither video says so, because neither presenter is paying your bill.
And one of these contradicts Recipe 05
Recipe 05 — her own strategy video — says this:
"people care most about the results you can demonstrate... just document your journey and your goal."
These two say this:
"if you love Alex Hormozi and you're inspired by his reels, you can drop one of these reels into this automation... generate your own version in your voice."
Both are hers. They point in opposite directions. I am not resolving that for you — but if you ever reach for one of these, it is worth knowing the same person argued against it elsewhere.
What is genuinely worth taking, if anything
Nothing else here transfers. Four videos, one product, and a subscription you do not have.
The one number worth remembering
She opens the August video with: "I've grown from zero to 3 million followers in 2 years solo with no budget, no team, and no ads."
In the September 2025 strategy video it was 1.4 million. Not a contradiction — eleven months of growth. But it is a reminder that every number in these videos has a date on it.
See also
RECIPE 01, 03, 04 and 09 all cover the same product from other angles. Five of the twelve you flagged are about one app. That is the single clearest finding of the whole set.
